_note: The people: five trainer's cards and eight buyers. Two drawings, thirteen figures. A specialization is one person on one map taking you on, so its figure is a hand-written card with one seal — deliberately the expert paper's opposite number, which is why it is a second drawing rather than `expert.tex` with both seals the same. A buyer is somebody standing on the other side of your counter, so the eight are one figure with a pose: what tells them apart is what they carry and how they stand. The ids here must match `class::SPECIALIZATIONS` and `data/stall.json`; `every_person_in_the_game_has_a_figure` is what says so.

_marks._note: What is scored into the wax, one a bench. A number rather than a name because `\ifnum` is what TikZ can branch on.
